basis: V1 independently reviewed originals: 5*3850 + 4*4275 + 3*6890 + 2*5420. V2 manually supplies those known facts with unresolved geometry; it is not a parser accuracy run.

expectations.contradictoryContent: Field approval fails, no obligation or transfer.
expectations.quantityConflict: Supplier claim 71710 preserved, po_mismatch and receipt_mismatch remain after field review, zero recognition/payment.
expectations.duplicateDelivery: Renamed identical packet and operation replay preserve one case/bill/recognition/payment/settlement.
expectations.sameFilenameDifferentSource: Changed source hash plus distinct invoice identity remains a separate held case.
expectations.preAuthorizationRevision: Old field approval invalidated; recognized unsent reservation cancels if present, stale authorization fails.
expectations.queuedUnsentRevision: Original command cancelled, reservations released, zero bank sends, reapproval of posted correction prohibited.
expectations.possibleSendRevision: Original request/key/reservations retained, no replacement payment, reconciliation may finish original payment.
expectations.staleSelfApproval: Old revision/hash, anonymous/agent/foreign issuer and own-created case approval fail.
expectations.lostResponse: Original operation lookup recovers one persisted FakeBank transfer; no second create; settlement one cash journal.
expectations.interruptedPosting: Bank observed settled does not imply local posting. Failure rolls back journal/balances; retry posts once; duplicate notices/observations do not duplicate economic effects.
expectations.geometry: Wrong page/frame, stale source revision and missing/duplicate/mismatched text must not produce accepted precise binding. Interrupted fallback stays unresolved; successful retry may derive exact regions.
